styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Every token and component, in both themes and both languages.
styleguide.sampleText: Casa Artis is a cultural venue with event rooms and guest accommodation.

admin.storageWarn: Storage is above 80%. Free up space from the Storage page.
admin.storageCritical: Storage is above 90%. Uploads stop at 100%.
admin.storageFull: Storage is full. New uploads are blocked until you free up space.
admin.inviteIntroEmail: The user gets an email with a link, valid for 72 hours, to choose their password.
admin.inviteIntroNoEmail: Email isn't configured: you'll get a link to copy and send to the user.
admin.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen; 3–32 characters.
admin.usernameRenameHint: Can be changed any time; entries stay with the user.
admin.searchUsers: Search by name, username, email or role
admin.rootUsernameLocked: The root admin's username can't be changed.
admin.rootRoleLocked: The root admin always stays an admin.
admin.roleChangeHint: Changing the role signs the user out everywhere.
admin.inviteLinkText: Send this link to {name}. They use it to choose a password.
admin.resetLinkText: Send this link to {name}. They use it to choose a new password.
admin.inviteValidity: The link is valid for 72 hours and works once.
admin.resetValidity: The link is valid for 60 minutes and works once.
admin.removePasskeysText: {name} will be able to sign in only with a password until they add a new passkey.
admin.revokeSessionsText: {name} will be signed out on every device.
admin.transferRootText: {name} becomes the root admin. You stay an admin.
admin.disableText: The user can no longer sign in and every session is closed. Their entries stay as they are.
admin.deleteText: The account will be deleted permanently.
admin.deleteHasUpcoming: {n, plural, one {This user owns an upcoming entry} other {This user owns # upcoming entries}}. Transfer them to another user first.
admin.transferRequired: Required: upcoming entries need an owner.
admin.formerUserNote: Past entries that aren't transferred show the saved name, marked “former user”.
admin.spacesIntro: The event rooms. This order is used in forms and filters.
admin.roomsIntro: Guest rooms for visitors and trainers.
admin.noSpacesText: Add the first room so events can be scheduled.
admin.noRoomsText: Add guest rooms so bookings can be made.
admin.nUpcomingEntries: {n, plural, =0 {no upcoming entries} one {# upcoming entry} other {# upcoming entries}}
admin.nUpcomingBookings: {n, plural, =0 {no upcoming bookings} one {# upcoming booking} other {# upcoming bookings}}
admin.venueInUse: Disable it or move its entries first.
admin.timeZoneHint: The whole calendar uses this zone, whatever the device's zone.
admin.capHint: At most {max} GB (set on the server).
admin.promoTemplateHelp: The starting caption for posts created from events. Lines whose placeholder is empty are dropped.
admin.emailOnText: Invitations and resets are sent by email (sender: {from}).
admin.emailOffText: Set SMTP_URL on the server to send emails. Until then, copy the links by hand.
admin.demoOnText: Demo accounts work on a separate copy, reset daily at {hour}:00. The setting comes from the server (ENABLE_DEMO_ACCOUNTS).
admin.demoOffText: Demo accounts are turned off on the server (ENABLE_DEMO_ACCOUNTS=0).
admin.resetDemoText: Demo data goes back to the sample. Real data isn't touched.
admin.demoSettingsReadOnly: In demo mode, settings are read-only.
admin.backupText: Download a .zip with the databases and media files. An automatic backup runs every night and is kept for 7 days.
admin.backupDemo: The demo workspace isn't backed up.
